title: Confirm the correct morning location before starting FORTNA OptiSweep Training Day 2
summary: Before beginning FORTNA OptiSweep Training Day 2, confirm you are physically at the correct morning location. The training video title slide includes the note: "[NOTE: Morning Location is Different]".
when_to_use: Use this pre-start check immediately before starting FORTNA OptiSweep Training Day 2 when the training title slide indicates the morning location is different.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the pre-start check to confirm the correct morning location before beginning the training session.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the Day 2 training title slide (or the training video frame containing the note)

access_required: Day 2 training title slide / training video frame that contains the note "[NOTE: Morning Location is Different]"

visual_references.description: Training video title slide frame showing: "FORTNA OptiSweep Training - Day 2 [NOTE: Morning Location is Different]"

steps.title: Review the Day 2 training title slide note
steps.purpose: Identify the pre-start instruction that the morning location may differ for Day 2.
steps.instruction: Open the FORTNA OptiSweep Training Day 2 title slide (or the training video frame) and read the note shown on the slide.
steps.expected_result: The note "[NOTE: Morning Location is Different]" is visible on the Day 2 title slide.
steps.healthy_condition: You can clearly see the slide text "FORTNA OptiSweep Training - Day 2" and the note "[NOTE: Morning Location is Different]".
steps.failure_condition: You cannot find the title slide note or the note text is not visible/legible.

actions.label: Verify the morning location note is present
actions.exact_action: Review the Day 2 training title slide note: "[NOTE: Morning Location is Different]".

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Slide note states: "[NOTE: Morning Location is Different]".

evidence_source_refs.retrieval_text: Training video slide frame captured at 00:00:01.500.
evidence_source_refs.ocr_text: FORTNA OptiSweep Training - Day 2 [NOTE: Morning Location is Different]

steps.title: Verify you are physically at the correct morning location
steps.purpose: Ensure you start Day 2 at the correct location indicated by the note.
steps.instruction: Before beginning the training session, confirm your physical presence at the correct morning location for FORTNA OptiSweep Training Day 2.
steps.expected_result: You are physically at the correct morning location for Day 2.
steps.healthy_condition: You have confirmed (by your physical location) that you are at the correct morning location for the Day 2 session.
steps.failure_condition: You are not at the correct morning location for Day 2.

actions.label: Confirm physical location
actions.exact_action: Verify you are physically at the correct morning location for Day 2 before beginning the training session.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Slide note states: "[NOTE: Morning Location is Different]" (used to drive the pre-start location check).

steps.title: If not at the correct location, stop and confirm with the training organizer
steps.purpose: Prevent starting the training session from the wrong location.
steps.instruction: If you cannot confirm you are at the correct morning location, stop before beginning Day 2 and confirm the correct location with the training organizer/instructor.
steps.expected_result: Either (a) you confirm you are at the correct location and proceed, or (b) you stop and confirm the correct location with the training organizer/instructor.
steps.healthy_condition: You do not begin the training session until the correct morning location is confirmed.
steps.failure_condition: You begin the training session while you are not at the correct morning location and have not confirmed the correct location.

actions.label: Stop and confirm location
actions.exact_action: If you are not at the correct morning location, stop and confirm the correct location with the training organizer before proceeding.

stop_or_escalate_if: You cannot confirm the correct morning location.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Slide note states: "[NOTE: Morning Location is Different]" (drives the stop-and-confirm behavior when location is uncertain).

success_criteria: You are physically at the correct morning location for FORTNA OptiSweep Training Day 2.
healthy_conditions: The Day 2 title slide note "[NOTE: Morning Location is Different]" is visible.
You have confirmed your physical presence at the correct morning location before starting.
failure_conditions: You cannot confirm the correct morning location and proceed anyway.
The title slide note cannot be found/verified.
escalation_guidance: Escalate to the training organizer/instructor if you cannot confirm the correct morning location.

missing_details: The packet does not specify the actual morning location name/address—only that it is different—so the organizer/instructor confirmation is required when you cannot determine the correct location.
